summary: A 40-person team of experienced network-security engineers can build a segmentation-plus-inspection platform, but the MVP bundles four hard products (discovery, inline DPI, TLS decryption, malware integrations) across three hypervisor/cloud data planes in 20 months. Inline traffic steering per platform and software DPI throughput are unproven; scope must shrink.

objections.objection: Inline east-west inspection requires steering every flow through the security microservices on each platform. VMware, OpenStack/KVM and AWS each expose different (or no) insertion points: AWS security groups only allow/deny by address, port and protocol and offer no inline service-insertion hook, so the product needs host agents/overlays or routing tricks per cloud, contradicting 'no endpoint agents' and multiplying the integration surface.

Software DPI with signatures, plus TLS decryption, on east-west traffic (often far higher volume than north-south) in horizontally scaled containers adds latency and compute cost per workload; the concept itself lists performance as the hardest part and has no benchmark target or fail-open design.

East-west TLS decryption needs private keys or a man-in-the-middle CA inside every application path; for internal service-to-service traffic (mutual TLS, pinned certs) this is often impossible or breaks apps. The concept leaves 'how much east-west traffic is encrypted' as an open question, yet inspection value depends on it.
Keeping threat definitions current needs a dedicated research and signature team or a licensed feed; neither is in the team plan or pricing.

MVP scope is too broad for 20 months: automatic discovery, application-aware policy, DPI, TLS decryption, URL filtering, malware integrations and REST APIs across three platforms. Shipping one platform (e.g. VMware/KVM) with segmentation plus IPS first is realistic; the full list is not.

strongest_point: Large, experienced team of distributed-systems and network-security engineers led by serial founders; containerised, scale-out inspection is a sound architecture for elastic capacity.
what_would_change_my_mind: A prototype sustaining at least 10 Gbps of east-west IPS inspection per host with under 1 ms added latency on one platform.
A documented traffic-steering design for each of VMware, KVM and AWS that needs no in-guest agent.
A phased MVP that ships one platform within 12 months.
